Cards now adjust automatically to their content:

- **Title only:** notes with an empty Markdown body use a shorter card, keeping the two-line title, note menu, continuation arrow and connection handle. Frontmatter and blank lines do not require a full-height preview.
- **With content:** notes keep their normal preview height. Adding or removing content updates the card size, and same-day cards stack using their actual heights.
- **Notebook:** title-only cards also omit the empty preview space.

**Predictable title fallback:** the configured title property takes precedence. If it is missing or empty, the card shows the complete filename without `.md`, including any date prefix. Notes and filenames are not rewritten.

Validated with thirty-six automated tests, seven focused checks inside desktop Obsidian, and visual inspection in the dedicated development vault.

Requires Obsidian 1.10.2 or later. Install `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` below. GitHub Actions builds, checks, attests and verifies all three files before publication.
